summary: Exact integer recomputation confirms all eight representation counts and the support-72 substitution. Frozen manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match. These arithmetic results support the stated size comparison without providing runtime evidence.

checks.scope: Representation counts and baseline degree-support arithmetic
checks.method: Independently evaluated 28*n and Python math.comb(n,4) for each displayed capacity, then substituted m=28, r=4 and D=19 into the support inequality.
checks.observation: Capacities 85,72,56,53 give respectively 2380,2016,1568,1484 incidence bits and 2024785,1028790,367290,292825 four-subsets, exactly as printed. The baseline is 19n+868<=2240, so n<=floor(1372/19)=72; n=72 gives 2236 while n=73 gives 2255. The counts describe two representation choices, not search-node counts, measured speedups, or exclusion certificates.
